description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the SearchResult interface, representing search results with pagination support, including JSON serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchResult
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the SearchResult interface, providing methods for handling search results with pagination, JSON serialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns a new empty SearchResult instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableSearchResult with specified items, nextPageOffset, and cursor.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableSearchResult instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the items in the search result.

methods.name: getNextPageOffset
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the next page offset.

methods.name: getCursor
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the cursor.

methods.name: hasNextPage
methods.description: Indicates if there is a next page available.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the search result is empty.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a stream of the items.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the items.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the search result to a JSON object with schema version and optional fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
